title: Achieving highly efficient, mechanically robust and thermally stable organic solar cells through optimizing the branching position and side chain length of small molecule acceptors
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,2342-2352
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04969A, Paper
Di Zhang, Junfeng Liu, Xiang Gao, Zhi Wang, Jiayi He, Zhenye Wang, Lvpeng Yang, Yerun Gao, Ming Shao
Highly efficient, mechanically robust, and thermally stable OSCs have been developed by optimizing the branching position and side chain length of SMAs, marking a significant advancement in the field of intrinsically stretchable OSCs.
